business.name: Brightwater Family Dental
business.tagline: Family dentistry · Cleanings · Fillings · Urgent visits
business.description: a family dental office in the Nashville, Tennessee area

wording.formIntro: Our scheduling assistant (an AI) answers in seconds, checks open times and books your appointment.
wording.formPlaceholder: Example: I need a cleaning and checkup, and I am a new patient.
wording.noQuote: We will go over the cost with you at your visit.
wording.bookedAfter: We will see you then. Reply here if anything changes.
wording.askService: what would you like to book (for example a cleaning, an exam, a filling or a whitening consultation)?

hours.text: Mon-Thu 8 AM-5 PM, Fri 8 AM-noon Central

urgency.label: Dental emergency
urgency.safetyNote: If you have trouble breathing or swallowing, call 911 first.
urgency.handoffReason: Dental emergency (severe pain, knocked-out tooth, heavy bleeding or facial swelling): priority callback, call the patient now.
